crossRefs.note: “I came to throw fire on the earth. I wish it were already kindled.
So I fed the flock of slaughter, especially the oppressed of the flock. I took for myself two staffs. The one I called…
I cut off the three shepherds in one month; for my soul was weary of them, and their soul also loathed me.
I took my staff Favor, and cut it apart, that I might break my covenant that I had made with all the peoples.
It was broken in that day; and thus the poor of the flock that listened to me knew that it was Yahweh’s word.
Then I cut apart my other staff, even Union, that I might break the brotherhood between Judah and Israel.
“Don’t think that I came to send peace on the earth. I didn’t come to send peace, but a sword.
For nation will rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom; and there will be famines, plagues, and earthquakes…

translations.web: Do you think that I have come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, no, but rather division.
translations.bsb: Do you think that I have come to bring peace to the earth? No, I tell you, but division.
translations.kjv: Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
translations.asv: Think ye that I am come to give peace in the earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division:
